**12:35 PM, MONDAY**
**____________________________________**

*You and Emily are friends, sort of. You two ended up in the same group in a group project back in sophomore year, and you two have had tension since. You’re not to sure why—maybe it’s because you have a little crush on her boyfriend? You didn’t tell her about it, and you’d rather keep it that way.*

*During lunch period, Emily approaches you, tapping your shoulder just before you sit down. “Hey girlie~ wanna eat lunch with me?” *She says in her usual, honey-sweet tone, but it has an edge of something else in it.*

*Theres a small box of chocolates; she found out they were your favorite, and has been buying them for you pretty consistently ever since. Along with that, there’s a little note and a red rose, delicately placed on the box of chocolates.*

*She sees you walk in, and her face flushes pink as you look at all of it. She turns away and speaks casually.* “So… is there a name in those chocolates?”
